answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The onyx is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the violet.
